-- Migration: backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv (code -> tier):
--   A -> gold
--   B -> silver
--   C -> bronze

ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN reward_band TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET reward_band = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
  ELSE NULL
END;
